errors.evidence: The chart itself does not contain any information indicating the geographical location is Germany. This information is external to the figure.
The value for the 'Frauen' line in 2019 is not 7.1. It is at its peak, approximately 7.15, almost identical to the value for 'Männer'. The value 7.1 is closer to the 2018 data point for 'Frauen'.

errors.text_span: Beide Linien beginnen 2011 bei etwa 6,9 (Männer) und 7,0 (Frauen), verlaufen bis 2019 relativ stabil mit leichten Schwankungen
errors.evidence: The prompt explicitly instructs to avoid making comparisons between lines ("Vermeiden Sie es, ... Vergleiche zwischen Linien anzustellen"). The description violates this rule repeatedly by describing the trends of both lines simultaneously (e.g., "Beide Linien beginnen...", "fällt die Lebenszufriedenheit beider Gruppen deutlich ab", "Ab 2022 steigen beide Linien wieder an"). The lines should have been described sequentially and independently.
The term "deutlich ab" (clearly drops) is subjective and evaluative language. The prompt requests a neutral, technical description.

errors.text_span: was einem Niveau nahe dem von 2019 entspricht
errors.evidence: This phrase makes a comparison between two different time points (2024 and 2019), which is an interpretive summary rather than a direct, objective description of the line's path as requested.

errors.text_span: die die Streuung oder Unsicherheit der Messwerte anzeigen
errors.evidence: This phrase explains the statistical meaning of error bars. The prompt asks for an objective description of the visual features, not an interpretation of what those features represent.
